scope: Original reusable visual-grammar descriptions informed by actual method-figure inspection. External source art remains link-only; bundled previews are our original schematic figures.
selection: Choose by source mechanism and desired emphasis, then adapt; profiles are optional and may be combined. Existing accepted reference and explicit user requirements take precedence.

profiles.name: Pale role surfaces with a focal relation
profiles.composition: Align genuinely parallel branches and place the actual interaction at their meeting point. Keep supporting panels quieter than the focal mechanism.
profiles.glyphVocabulary: Direct native model shapes, small modality glyphs and meaningful representation fragments. Preserve input-image identity through original schematic artwork or an explicit illustration exception.
profiles.typography: Dark body/module ink on pale surfaces; short local phase captions. A localized dark core with readable light ink is an available variation, not a ban.
profiles.paint: Role hue may appear in outline, connector and small glyphs; pale surface is separate from accent. Give focal warm/cool contrast a declared scientific meaning.
profiles.connectors: Mostly restrained structural routes. Reuse a role accent when tracing the same representation; keep model reuse/control distinguishable from data flow.
avoid: Large saturated heading bars that compete with the mechanism
An equal card for every code node

profiles.name: Repeated representation categories
profiles.composition: Repeat the same category vocabulary across aligned stages; use source-supported changes in count, grouping or position to show the operation.
profiles.glyphVocabulary: Native small tokens, stack/sequence/group patterns and local category labels. Exact token/layer counts require evidence; example counts are declared schematic.
profiles.typography: Place category words near the recurring pattern. Preserve paper-width legibility; do not shrink labels to fit a dense author layout.
profiles.paint: Categories occupy small glyphs while surrounding model blocks remain quieter. Reuse a local key or direct label, and keep meaning visible in geometry or text.
profiles.connectors: Connect the transformation, not every decorative token. Distinguish input/output categories from gradients and persistent state.
avoid: A token palette automatically painted across all modules
Copying literal layer counts or dense mini-text from source art

profiles.name: Overview with a targeted detail inset
fit: One local operation that needs a concrete example
profiles.composition: Keep one overview path and enlarge only the region needed to understand the central distinction. Stage/region identity may live in outline and line style rather than heavy filled panels.
profiles.glyphVocabulary: Source-derived document/tree/image fragments, native crop frames or a magnified local replacement. Schematic examples are marked in companion records.
profiles.typography: A small number of local mechanism captions with consistent heading/body levels. Keep enough context to interpret the enlarged fragment.
profiles.paint: Use a restrained shared highlight to bind selected source region and inset. Keep distinct scientific channels separately keyed; photos do not define schematic palette.
profiles.connectors: Separate magnification links from directed information arrows; retain selection provenance.
avoid: A decorative zoom with no scientific operation
Turning every detail into a competing main panel

profiles.name: Structural ink with selective relation accents
fit: A mechanism already clear from graph and labels
profiles.composition: Use white/neutral modules and explicit relationships. Keep empty space around the central relation; avoid an unnecessary large panel.
profiles.glyphVocabulary: Simple native boxes, optional small state symbols and explicit endpoint roles. Use icons only when their semantic meaning is needed.
profiles.typography: Dark text and concise edge labels. Geometry and line pattern carry meaning alongside hue.
profiles.paint: Use very little fill. Assign any accent to an actual relation/state; neutral arrows are sufficient when no extra scientific category exists.
profiles.connectors: Directional read/update/reuse relations need source support and redundant labels or dashes; red/green alone is insufficient.
avoid: Adding read/write modules just to use the style
Treating monochrome as universally more professional
